baseline_models.focus_anchor: The containing construction لَفِى joins ضَلَٰلٍ to مُّبِينٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ض ل ل branch of departure from guidance supplies a wrong course, while the ب ي ن branch of emergence and uncovering makes that departure inspectably manifest. The clause therefore names not only error but occupancy within an exposed deviation.

activation_trace.role: Literal departure from guidance supplies the deviating course that contains the speaker.
Literal emergence and uncovering make the deviation exposed rather than merely asserted.

changed_reading.before: I would then plainly be mistaken.
changed_reading.after: I would then be enclosed in a departure from the intended way whose deviating character has come fully into view.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ضَلَٰلٍ can image loss, while مُّبِينٍ can image separation and widening distance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Loss becomes relational and spatial: something that should orient or hold the speaker is lost as a separation opens and widens. The preposition فِى turns the resulting interval into an inhabitable condition.

activation_trace.role: Literal loss supplies the broken possession or orientation at the center of the state.
Literal separation supplies the relational break through which the loss is experienced.
Literal widening distance expands the break into a condition from which recovery is difficult.

changed_reading.before: The clause assigns the speaker an incorrect belief.
changed_reading.after: The clause places the speaker inside a loss of orientation produced by separation and an expanding distance from what should hold him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The hiddenness branch of ض ل ل stands in productive tension with the uncovering and communicative branches of ب ي ن.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two focus roots can form a paradox rather than a simple synonym pair: the speaker would enter disappearance or concealment, yet that very condition would reveal and articulate itself. The error can be opaque from within while evident in its effects.

activation_trace.role: Literal disappearance and hiddenness supply the inward opacity of the condition.
Literal uncovering reverses hiddenness at the level of observable result.
Literal disclosure by speech or sign lets the concealed condition announce itself.

changed_reading.before: Clear error is error consciously recognized as clear.
changed_reading.after: I would be submerged in a concealment whose consequences nevertheless uncover and declare the condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence sets the one who originated the speaker and receives the return against adopted others whose joined intercession cannot extract him. Loss and separation in 36:24 thus become a failed-rescue relation: substitution severs orientation toward origin and return while installing protectors unable to recover what is lost.

activation_trace.role: Literal loss anchors the focus state as something no substitute can recover.
Literal separation anchors the relational break caused by taking others.
Literal origination identifies the relation from which the hypothetical substitution departs.
Literal return supplies the destination whose orientation is lost.
Literal otherness supplies the substituted side of the separation.
Literal joining of an intercessor supplies the proposed repair that the clause denies as sufficient.
Literal extraction from peril supplies the rescue function the adopted gods cannot perform.

structural_cues: 36:22 moves from origination to return; 36:23 tests substitute-taking under harm; إِذًا in 36:24 marks the resulting state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies origin, return, otherness, joined intercession, and denied extraction. I infer that substitution causes relational loss and failed recovery; a live alternative is that 36:24 only judges a false proposition without imaging a rescue system.

changed_reading.before: Taking other gods would simply be an incorrect choice.
changed_reading.after: Taking others would place me in a relational loss: cut from the line of origin and return, I would rely on attachments incapable of retrieving me.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, the straight road is opposed by sealed gaps, covering, failed sight, and an openly hostile agent who leads people away; the late counterfactual even combines erased sight with racing for the road. The focus deviation is therefore embodied as route and perception capture, not only a mistaken conclusion.

activation_trace.role: Literal departure from guidance anchors the focus as a failed course.
The literal straight road supplies the positive route from which focus deviation departs.
Literal closure of a breach and barrier-making turn the route into an enclosure before and behind.
A literal covering supplies the perceptual veil operating inside the enclosure.
Literal eye-sight, here negated, makes failure to see part of failed orientation.
Literal gentle direction to the road supplies the contrasting state of those to be followed.
The rebellious adversarial figure supplies an agent for route capture rather than an agentless mistake.
Literal enmity specifies that the agent's directional work is hostile.
The repeated literal straight road places worship and direction in one mechanism.
Causative leading away turns the focus's state of deviation into the result of hostile direction.
Literal loss of light and sight supplies the extreme counterfactual form of perceptual capture.

structural_cues: The road appears near the opening at 36:4, beside the enemy and leading-astray sequence at 36:60-62, and inside a sight counterfactual at 36:66.
36:9 coordinates front and rear barriers, covering, and inability to see in one spatial-perceptual scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies roads, barriers, covering, negated sight, guidance, an enemy, and causative leading astray. I infer that these elements form one route-perception mechanism; a live alternative is that they are separate moral and eschatological images.

changed_reading.before: Error is an internally held wrong opinion.
changed_reading.after: I would be caught inside a hostile route-system in which the true course, the ability to see it, and the ability to move by it are jointly lost.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated ب ي ن constructions connect clarity to a written register that preserves traces, a delivery that reaches its hearer, bodily speech and testimony, and a recited disclosure. In the focus, مُّبِينٍ can therefore make deviation auditable: error leaves readable evidence and speaks through its effects.

activation_trace.role: Literal disclosure by speech or sign anchors the focus adjective as evidentiary communication.
Literal writing supplies a durable medium in which conduct becomes readable.
A literal remaining mark supplies evidence that points back to prior action.
Literal exhaustive counting makes the register comprehensive rather than impressionistic.
Literal visibility and uncovering characterize the register that contains deeds and traces.
Literal delivery of a message supplies clarity's communicative movement toward an audience.
Literal verbal or sign-based disclosure makes the delivery revealing, not merely transmitted.
Literal intelligible speech lets embodied action articulate what the sealed mouth does not.
Literal declaration from knowledge turns bodily traces into testimony.
Literal recitation supplies an audible form of ordered disclosure.
Literal revelation of meaning by expression aligns the final clear recitation with evidentiary clarity.

structural_cues: 36:12 coordinates writing, prior deeds, remaining traces, exhaustive counting, and a clear register.
36:65 reverses ordinary testimony by sealing mouths while hands speak and feet testify.
مُّبِين occurs with delivery at 36:17 and recitation at 36:69, repeatedly tying clarity to communication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies written traces, exhaustive counting, clear delivery, bodily testimony, and clear recitation. I infer that repeated ب ي ن makes the focus error evidentially self-disclosing; a live alternative is that each adjective independently means only easy to understand.

changed_reading.before: Manifest error is simply very obvious error.
changed_reading.after: The error would be manifest because it produces a recordable, readable, and ultimately testifying pattern that discloses what state I occupy.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 36:47 the exact ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ construction is spoken by rejecters against those who call for feeding from provision. The phrase is therefore socially reversible: opposing parties can deploy the same clarity claim, so the focus speaker's first-person conditional becomes a polemical boundary statement whose validity depends on the causal mechanism, not on the label alone.

activation_trace.role: Literal deviation anchors the focus speaker's self-locating accusation.
Literal manifestness anchors the focus claim that one side's deviation is exposed.
Literal expenditure supplies the disputed act around which the mirrored accusation forms.
Literal apportioned gift frames feeding as redistribution of what was already given.
Literal covering of a blessing characterizes the speakers who redirect the error label.
Literal feeding of another supplies the concrete practice judged as deviation by the opposing voice.
The repeated literal deviation reverses who accuses whom while preserving the focus wording.
The repeated literal manifestness shows that confidence in clarity is available to both opposed judgments.

structural_cues: 36:24 is first-person and conditional; 36:47 is second-person, restrictive, and accusatory, but both end with the same two rooted words.
The later echo occurs inside a dispute over feeding, not substitute worship, changing both speaker and tested action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact phrase recurrence with reversed speaker and target in a provision-and-feeding dispute. I infer a deliberate polemical echo that makes the label contestable; a live alternative is independent use of a common formula.

changed_reading.before: The speaker privately recognizes an uncontested category of obvious error.
changed_reading.after: The speaker publicly locates himself across a contested boundary, using a formula that opponents can mirror and forcing the hearer to test which action actually produces deviation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly moves between inattention and remembering, covering and seeing, unseen response, stripping away a layer, secrecy and publicity, and forgetting origin. These toggles activate the focus tension between ض ل ل as hiddenness or failed preservation and ب ي ن as uncovering: deviation can consist in an interior loss of access while signs and outcomes expose it.

activation_trace.role: Literal concealment anchors error as disappearance from the subject's accessible field.
Literal loss of preservation anchors the cognitive form of failed access and memory.
Literal uncovering supplies the outward reversal by which hidden error becomes visible.
Literal inattention leaves warning outside active awareness and supplies an early cognitive analogue to hidden deviation.
Literal covering supplies the material form of concealed perception.
Literal bringing to mind after or alongside forgetting supplies the counter-operation to loss of preservation.
Literal concealment from eyes shows that valid response can occur without present visibility.
Literal removal of a covering supplies a dynamic image for revelation through stripping.
Literal inward concealment supplies one pole of the explicitly paired secret-public field.
Literal public appearance supplies the other pole and makes concealment non-protective.
Literal loss of remembrance makes forgotten origin generate an argument whose error is outwardly visible.

structural_cues: 36:11 places following reminder beside awe in the unseen.
36:76 explicitly coordinates what is hidden and what is public under one knowing.
36:77-78 joins a manifest disputant to forgetting his own creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated concealment-revelation pairs and a final forgetful argument. I infer that the focus roots compress those pairs into hidden error with exposed effects; a live alternative is that ضلال uses only its directional branch and these motifs remain separate.

changed_reading.before: Manifestness means the erring person can directly see the error.
changed_reading.after: I could lose access through inattention, covering, or forgetting while the resulting speech and conduct still strip the condition open to view.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first gathers everyone into presence and then commands a distinct criminal group to separate, while the manifest enemy is named as the one who led many away. The ب ي ن separation branch turns the focus clause into social and judicial self-placement: the hypothetical choice would put the speaker on the side eventually partitioned out.

activation_trace.role: Literal separation anchors manifest error as a boundary-producing state.
Literal gathering of what was dispersed supplies the common field before sorting.
Literal presence and nearness make the gathered field available for judgment.
Literal sorting until one thing is distinct from another realizes the separating movement.
Literal culpability identifies the group partitioned from the gathered whole.
Literal enemy relation supplies the opposing allegiance behind the partition.
Literal manifestness marks the enemy relation as disclosed before the separation is completed.
Literal causative deviation links hostile allegiance to the group later sorted out.

structural_cues: 36:32 gathers all into presence; 36:59 then issues an imperative of separation.
36:60-62 places the manifest enemy, the straight path, and causative leading astray immediately after the sorting command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, presence, explicit sorting, culpability, a manifest enemy, and leading astray. I infer that focus separation anticipates a later social-judicial partition; a live alternative is that the focus adjective has no sorting force.

changed_reading.before: The hypothetical error is an individual mental condition.
changed_reading.after: The hypothetical choice would locate me within an allegiance that becomes a visible boundary and is ultimately separated from the gathered whole.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the animal-specific stray branch of ض ل ل and the land-tract branch of ب ي ن into an abstract moral clause. It remains anchored in both focus roots and is activated by the later livestock, ownership, taming, false-god, failed-aid, and mustered-army sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory ownership image, not as a lexical translation of the focus phrase.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ضَلَٰلٍ activates the stray animal left in a wasting place, and مُّبِينٍ activates a tract extending within sight.

activation_trace.role: The literal ownerless stray in a wasting place supplies the focus image of displaced belonging.
The literal tract extending across sight supplies the exposed waste in which the stray remains.
Literal ownership supplies the human-animal relation that the outlier later reverses.
Literal taming and facilitation after difficulty supplies the controlled livestock side of the reversal.
Literal otherness marks the beings adopted in place of the true ownership relation.
Literal aid, here denied, shows that the supposed owners or protectors cannot recover their dependents.
A literal mutually supporting host reverses the expected direction of protection: the worshippers become the gods' mustered force.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, I would become like a stray in an exposed waste after inverting ownership: attached to supposed protectors who cannot retrieve me and for whom I instead stand mustered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the divorce branch of ب ي ن is legally specific and morphologically distant from a routine reading of مُّبِينٍ. It remains focus-anchored and gains a mechanism from origination, return, and covenant, but no marriage construction is supplied. Downstream prose should call it a contained legal echo of severance without easy return, never the direct meaning of the adjective.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مُّبِينٍ activates the branch of a separation that cuts off return, while ضَلَٰلٍ activates loss.

activation_trace.role: Literal loss supplies what is endangered by a binding severance.
The literal legal separation that cuts off الرجعة supplies the outlier's irreversible relational image.
Literal origination supplies the primary relation from which severance would occur.
Literal return supplies the movement threatened by the branch image of cut-off الرجعة.
A literal preserved covenant supplies the binding relation breached by worship of the other.
The final literal return keeps the threatened relation active across the whole-surah frame.

changed_reading.before: The hypothetical choice would amount to obvious error.
changed_reading.after: As a contained legal echo, the choice would place me in a loss figured as binding severance from origin, covenant, and the line of return.

strongest_changes: The immediate 36:22-23 sequence converts generic error into relational loss and a failed-rescue system between origin, return, substitute attachment, and denied extraction.
The recurring road, barrier, sight, enemy, and causative-leading language embodies deviation as capture of both movement and perception.

Written traces, clear delivery, bodily testimony, and clear recitation make مُّبِين evidentiary and auditable, while the exact 36:47 echo shows that the same clarity claim can be polemically reversed.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet redistributes the two focus roots across barriers and intervals, records and messages, an exposed enemy, a clear recitation, a manifest disputant, and an exact accusation spoken by the opposing side. That distribution lets the compact focus clause operate spatially, relationally, evidentially, cognitively, and socially without collapsing those mechanisms into one reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The directional branch of ض ل ل is strongest; its concealment, failed-preservation, loss, and stray-animal branches may be productive activations rather than intended senses in 36:24.
The exact 36:47 recurrence strongly supports rhetorical mirroring, but the packet alone cannot decide whether it is deliberate echo or repeated formula.
The irrevocable-separation branch of ب ي ن remains too legally and morphologically distant to carry beyond a qualified outlier.
